verdict.rationale: No evidence in the pack describes built-in AI features for banking operations—no natural-language transaction search, no drafted dispute/alert responses, no anomaly summaries. The documentation only covers financial account management, connect integrations, fraud risk controls (automatic, non-AI-described), and money movement, none of which mention AI/LLM-based ops tooling. Missing for 10: any mention of natural-language search, AI-drafted dispute responses, anomaly summaries, or any AI/ML-powered ops feature.
